**Finding: Compliant** (rule LD — Liquidated damages and penalties payable by Customer)

The agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalty, kill fee, or minimum/early-termination charge on us:

- **§ 6(a)/(b) and § 7(c) (p0033, p0044):** on termination Contractor is paid only "all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned … through the effective date of such termination" — an accrued-amounts obligation, not a stipulated or liquidated sum. Termination for convenience is available to either party on 15 days' notice with no exit fee.
- **§ 3 (p0013–p0015):** time-and-materials compensation, expenses and taxes only; no late-payment penalty or default interest against us.
- **§ 7(a) (p0035):** our liability is capped at fees paid to Contractor, rather than any pre-agreed damages figure.

This satisfies the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so no redline was proposed. Noted for the file only: § 3(b) permits Contractor to change rates on 30 days' notice without a cap — a pricing point for the rate/uplift rule, not a liquidated damages issue under this rule.
